hero.subtitle: Interbeat watches the screen, the room and the person, so recruiters can focus on the conversation.

items.title: Live video
items.description: Peer-to-peer WebRTC. Video flows straight from candidate to recruiter, so it stays fast.

items.title: Computer-vision detection
items.description: Faces, hands and phones, checked on sampled frames to keep the load light.

items.title: Device telemetry
items.description: USB, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, cameras, monitors and running apps from the candidate's PC.

items.title: Kiosk lockdown
items.description: A native desktop window that browsers can't match: it sees the whole screen and locks the exam down.

items.question: Who and what is in frame?
items.description: Flags zero faces, more than one face, and a phone in view.

items.question: What are the hands doing?
items.description: Catches a hand lingering near the face or mouth.

items.question: Is it the same person?
items.description: Matches live frames against a reference photo, re-checked every 5 minutes.

deviceTelemetry.title: See the hardware, the moment it changes.
deviceTelemetry.description: A small agent on the candidate's PC reports what's connected. The recruiter's device page refreshes every 5 seconds and shows a red badge when anything changes.

kioskLockdown.title: A browser tab can't do this.

features.title: Native Electron window
features.description: Blocks what a tab can't: alt-tab, extra monitors and background apps. Bundles the device agent and launches it on join.

features.title: Hard to reverse-engineer
features.description: The desktop client is obfuscated and the agent is compiled to native code with Nuitka.

steps.title: 1. Set URLs
steps.description: Public URL in the env file

confidenceScore.title: One number the recruiter watches.
confidenceScore.description: It starts at 100 when the recruiter presses Start. Every integrity signal lowers it, and each cause has its own cap. Try it.
confidenceScore.note: Penalty and cap values here are for demonstration.

realTimeAlerts.title: No polling. Alerts arrive as they happen.
realTimeAlerts.description: Each interview is a room keyed by its join code. Detection, device and identity events stream to the recruiter's live monitor over Socket.IO, next to chat and the video feed.

events.msg: More than one face in frame

rolesAndCompanies.title: Licensed to companies. Safe by design.
rolesAndCompanies.permissionsNote: Permissions are enforced on the server, not just hidden in the screen.

Candidate: Joins by code through the kiosk desktop app
The only role that can self-register
Identified by name and a one-time join token
Verified against a reference photo before the exam proceeds
Recruiter: Created only by their own company manager
Creates, starts, ends and monitors interviews live
Sees every interview at their own company
The only role that can operate an interview
Company manager: One lead HR per client, created by the super admin
Adds recruiter accounts from a Team tab
Cannot start, end or delete interviews, or open live monitor
Super admin: Bootstrapped once by a script, never through the UI
Controls branding, companies and first accounts
Rebuilds and downloads the desktop installer
The only account that can create companies or see across them

facts.title: Own login per role
facts.description: Recruiter, company and admin each sign in on their own page.

facts.title: Company isolation
facts.description: A recruiter never sees another company's data.

facts.title: Live branding
facts.description: App name, logo and about text change instantly, no rebuild.

facts.title: One switch
facts.description: Deactivate a company and every login there is blocked.

platform.title: Four services. One door.
platform.subtitle: Heavy AI scales apart from light telemetry, and a single tunnel exposes the whole app.

features.title: bcrypt + JWT
features.description: Hashed passwords, signed tokens that expire after 24 hours, checked per resource.

features.title: Rate limiting
features.description: Login and register are capped per IP against brute force.

features.title: Dashboard key
features.description: Candidate device data can't be read by anyone with the URL.

features.title: Signed bridge
features.description: Services trust each other with a shared secret, compared in constant time.

features.title: Secrets in env
features.description: The app refuses to start in production on placeholder values.

features.title: PostgreSQL only
features.description: Built for many recruiters and candidates at once. No silent local fallback.

pricing.title: Licensed per company.
